operator.graph: CQ3_0 gate MUL_MAT plus CQ3_0 up MUL_MAT plus un-swapped F32 SwiGLU
operator.benchmark_weights: llama.cpp deterministic synthetic initialization at the exact operator shape; not real model artifact bytes

candidate.design: quantize the shared activation once, reuse each CQ8 group across eight gate and eight up rows, then apply GGML's native SwiGLU epilogue without materializing both complete projection tensors
candidate.dispatch: ARM-only three-node CPU graph fusion guarded by exact types, shape, contiguity, shared activation, and SwiGLU orientation

control.implementation: the same source, build, binary, graph, weights, inputs, and thread count with GGML_CPU_DISABLE_FUSION=1; two separately dispatched row-blocked CQ3 MUL_MAT nodes followed by GGML SwiGLU

correctness.paired_kernel_requirement: gate and up outputs bit-identical to two independent ARM row-blocked kernel calls
correctness.ggml_backend_reference_requirement: both fused graph cases pass the registered reference comparison

performance.paired_order: alternate control-first and candidate-first at process granularity
performance.measurement: each process runs one whole three-node graph repeatedly for about one second and reports microseconds per complete graph run
performance.normalization_invariant: run_whole_graph uses n_runs=1 because only the final output tensor is duplicated; ancestor nodes are not duplicated
performance.excluded_exploratory_lane: 18 threads is retained only as noisy mixed-core selection evidence and cannot decide this gate

promotion.scope: K2/K11 ARM CQ3_0 single-token fused gate/up/SwiGLU graph dispatch
promotion.claim_boundary: kernel and synthetic exact-shape graph evidence only; no model-quality, token-parity, end-to-end throughput, energy, or scientific-breakthrough claim

paired_row_candidates.4: exact; approximately 1.05x/1.10x/1.05x ratio of medians at 1/4/8 threads in three exploratory pairs
paired_row_candidates.8: exact; approximately 1.06x/1.12x/1.02x ratio of medians at 1/4/8 threads in three exploratory pairs
paired_row_candidates.16: exact but neutral or slower at 1/8/18 threads because 32 live vector accumulators caused register pressure

exploratory_basis.selection: eight paired rows retained for the preregistered run; exploratory timings cannot be mixed into the authoritative result
